### A framework for success
A successful rollout starts with leadership buy-in, sharing relevant examples of how the tools help daily work, and monitoring adoption to provide support where teams need it most.
[ Start planning ](https://explore.webex.com/adoption-methodology)
![A woman wearing a headset, interacting with a Cisco desk device during a video conference.](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/adopt/adoption_methodology.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Friction is normal—here's how to handle it
Progress stalls when awareness is low, relevance is unclear, and leadership visibility drops. Create momentum by sharing practical strategies with relatable use cases or get creative with gamification.
[ Get inspired ](https://explore.webex.com/overcome-hurdles)
![Two colleagues collaborating in a meeting room, using a large interactive display for a brainstorming session.](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/adopt/get_inspired.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Track progress and create your success story
As your rollout progresses, check in on how you're tracking toward your goals. Use built-in tools to monitor usage and business outcomes, and capture success stories along the way.
[ See how ](https://explore.webex.com/measure-success)
![A team in a conference room participating in a hybrid meeting, with a large screen displaying business analytics.](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/adopt/share_success.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies
  * ### Functional Cookies


#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

FAQs
Find answers to commonly asked questions so you can connect with the programs that matter you to most
  * Webex Insider
  * Advocacy
  * User Group
  * User Research


Is the Webex Insider program part of the Cisco Insider Program? 
Yes it is! The Webex Insider program is powered by Cisco Insider. Click here to learn more about the [Cisco Insider program](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/about/cisco-insider.html). 
Do I need to register again if I am already part of the Cisco Insider Program? 
For the Webex Advocacy and User Group programs you will not need to register again. For joining User Research please complete this brief [registration form](https://ciscochannels.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9Zj1nm0wk6XsWuq).
What is the Webex Insider Advocates program? 
The Webex Insider Advocates program was formerly known as the Webex Ambassadors program. We have rebranded and relaunched this program as a loyalty and rewards program for Webex customers to earn points for completing activities of their choice (share social posts, complete trainings & certifications, participate in case studies, user research, etc.) and redeem exclusive rewards. We’ve partnered with Influitive to host the program on this platform, which you may be familiar with if you’re a Cisco Insider Advocate too. Join the program [here](https://insideradvocates.cisco.com/forum/).
What are the perks of being a Webex Insider Advocate? 
There are intangible and tangible benefits to being a Webex Insider Advocate. You'll have a one stop shop central location to get the latest and greatest Webex news such as a new product release and upcoming events. You'll also have the opportunity to connect with your peers in the industry to share your knowledge and learn from them. You can also cash in points for exclusive rewards available only to members like you.
Does the Webex Ambassadors program still exist? 
The Webex Ambassadors program has folded into the Webex Insider Advocates program. Prior Webex Ambassadors have automatically been added to the Webex Insider Advocates program if they are still a current Webex customer. The Webex Insider Advocate program can be accessed [here](https://insideradvocates.cisco.com/forum/).
I was in the process of taking the Webex Ambassador courses on GoLearn, how will I earn my badge(s)? 
Webex Ambassador courses on Webex Academy (formerly GoLearn) have been retired and we've launched the Webex Insider Advocates program to replace it. The new program includes fun challenges and opportunities to earn points that can be used to redeem rewards. Join the Webex Insider Advocates program [here](https://insideradvocates.cisco.com/forum/).
Can I invite my colleagues to join Webex Insider Advocates? 
Yes! We welcome all Webex customers to join the Webex Insider Advocates program. Our only requirements are that they be a current customer, are using Webex as an IT admin, and are advocates for Webex. Invite your colleagues to join the program [here](https://insideradvocates.cisco.com/forum/).
What is the Webex Insider User Group program and why should I join? 
The Webex Insider User Group enables you to engage with your peers plus Webex product teams, engineering teams and marketing teams to learn best practices and share real-life experiences using Webex solutions.
By joining the program, you’ll gain:
  * Direct access to product owners, subject matter experts and technical briefings
  * An opportunity to provide product feedback
  * Curated content and insight into the product roadmap
  * The ability to share your experiences and learn from your peers in an open forum


Does the Webex Experts program still exist? 
The Webex Experts program has folded into the Webex Insider User Group program. The Webex Insider User Group program can be accessed [here](https://community.cisco.com/t5/customer-connection/ct-p/ccp-home).
If I was already a Webex Expert do I need to re-enroll? 
No. Now that we are part of the Cisco Insider program your access will be maintained. 
What is the Webex Insider User Research? 
[Webex Insider User Research](https://ciscochannels.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9Zj1nm0wk6XsWuq) is a program through which you can actively participate in shaping the design and development of Webex products. Join our panel of collaboration users, partners, admins, and developers to directly influence our product direction. 
What do I get from the program? Why should I join? 
[By joining](https://ciscochannels.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9Zj1nm0wk6XsWuq) you will be added to our close contact list of forward thinkers and trailblazers. As a member, you'll have opportunities to participate in user studies, provide your feedback for launched products you already use, others that are still just a concept. You will get to share your wishes and ideas, as well as get an early glimpse into what we are working on and what is coming next for Webex!
What will be required from me? How often am I going to hear from you? 
Opting in to join our panel is easy and voluntary ([this survey](https://ciscochannels.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9Zj1nm0wk6XsWuq) will take ~2 minutes). Your contact details and product-interests will be used for Product / Research purposes only. We won't overwhelm your inbox: depending on our product roadmap and your interests and usage, you will be contacted up to 2-3 times per calendar year regarding participation in Cisco Webex Research. This includes invitations to participate in user studies, surveys, or opportunities to provide feedback. If you are not interested – you can ignore, ask to postpone, or withdraw from the program at any time simply by replying to our email.
What products are you covering? How can I participate only in studies and activities that are relevant and interesting to me? 
Our Webex Insider Research Program expands and stretches to cover anything Webex and collaboration: From AI/VR, meeting and messaging experiences and integrations, Contact Center, Control Hub and partner Hub, Calling, and everything in between (think: Migration to cloud! Interoperability! Devices and Smart Spaces experiences!). 
Tell us what you are curious or passionate about with Webex [when you join](https://ciscochannels.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_9Zj1nm0wk6XsWuq) or update your choices later.
More Questions? 
Contact us at webexuxr@cisco.com.

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy

#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Cookies Details

# Easy screen sharing in 2021 with Webex.
## Enjoy video-first meetings with integrated voice, video and screen sharing, that lets you collaborate more effectively with customers, partners, and employees--without the need to travel.
[ Start For Free ](https://cart.webex.com/sign-up)
## Do I have control over what I screen share?
With [Webex Meetings](https://www.webex.com/content/webex/c/en_US/index/video-conferencing.html) you can choose exactly what you want to   
share—no more, no less.
  * Share individual files or documents, such as a specific Word doc or PowerPoint.
  * Share entire application sets, such as productivity tools or web browsers.
  * Share multimedia viewers and players so you can show video or animation in a Webex Meeting at 30 frames per second.
  * Share your entire screen, including everything you have open and in view.


The choice is yours. You have complete control over   
what and when you share.
### Learn more about [screen sharing best practices](https://blog.webex.com/screen-share/best-screen-sharing-practices-for-small-businesses).
## Can I share screens from any device?
With Webex, you can share an application or your entire screen with remote attendees in real-time across any device-- even when you’re on the go. You can share your content or screen from your:
  * Browser.
  * Android devices.
  * iPhone or iPad devices. —You can even share 3D models virtually in your meetings from iOS devices!
  * Cisco Webex Device. Screenshare wirelessly to a Webex Device via Proximity. You can also share whiteboard sessions into a Webex meeting from a Webex Board.


[Start for Free](https://cart.webex.com/sign-up).
## Can anyone in my meeting share a screen? 
### Screen sharing isn’t limited to just the host. Your attendees can take control and share content as well. Best of all, you can collaborate together, in real-time, to keep your work moving forward.
  * Open a document and edit or mark-up the file together.
  * Start a whiteboard and draw your ideas, for all to see. You can use both text and graphic tools to whiteboard together as a group.


## How do I share my screen?
  1. Select Share in the control bar on your screen.
  2. Select to share your screen or application from the list of open applications.
     * To share an application that isn’t open, select Share, and Other Applications.
  3. To start a whiteboard session, select Share, and New Whiteboard.
  4. To stop screen sharing, select Stop Sharing on the floating bar at the top of the screen.
  5. You can also screenshare from your Webex Meetings desktop app when connected to a Webex device.


### Learn more on how to [share your screen](https://help.webex.com/en-us/5ddww5/Share-Content-in-Cisco-Webex-Meetings-and-Cisco-Webex-Events).

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies

#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies

#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies
  * ### Functional Cookies


#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies
  * ### Functional Cookies


#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies
  * ### Functional Cookies


#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

## Simplify webinars without compromising experience. 
Create engaging experiences for everyone, from small sessions to massive global audiences.
Reach everyone Accommodate up to 100,000 attendees and reach global audiences with real-time translations in 100+ languages.
Bring your brand identity Curate the attendee registration experience with custom branding options and themes.
Practice to perfection Rehearse the entire presentation with your co-panelists before you go live on stage.
Present like a pro Bring your presentations to life with immersive share by placing yourself directly on the content you share.
Engage the audience Encourage active participation with moderated Q&A, live polling, chat, emoji reactions, and gesture recognition.
Direct the show Manage the stage and content that your audience sees before, during, and after the event.
Make it accessible Let attendees listen to the event in their preferred language with live interpreters included in session.
Discuss in small groups Dive deeper into topics or get to know panelists more intimately with breakout sessions.
Integrates with your favorite apps Easily integrate with tools you use everyday including Miro, and Slido.

Still have questions about Webex Events?
What's the difference between Webex Events and Webex Webinars?
Webex Webinars is the ideal solution for intuitive, engaging webinars that scale with your business. If you're looking for an all-in-one event platform to power virtual, in-person and hybrid events–from multi-track conferences to tradeshows to networking events, Webex Events is the solution for you!
I'm a Webex Suite Enterprise Agreement customer. Do I have access to Webex Events?
Webex Events is included in A-FLEX-EA-SUITE, A-FLEX-EA-P-SUITE, A-FLEX-EA-MUL, A-FLEX-EA-MCL, E3C-WEBEX-SUITE, and E3H-WEBEX-SUITE plans. This list continues to expand, so check back for updates! To learn more about Webex Events and how to access as part of your plan, please contact your Webex Account Manager.
Can I purchase Webex Events separate from the Webex Suite?
No, Webex Events is exclusively offered as a part of select Webex Suite Enterprise Agreements. If you're a Suite Enterprise customer, contact your Webex Account Manager to see if Webex Events is a part of your plan!

#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

## Less monologue, more interaction.
![User has an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Create-meaningful-engagement.jpg)
![User has an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Foster-an-inclusive-culture.jpg)
![User has an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Build-stronger-connections.jpg)
* ![User has an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Create-meaningful-engagement.jpg)
###### Create meaningful engagement
Interact with participants at scale and ensure that everyone's engaged.
* ![User has an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Foster-an-inclusive-culture.jpg)
###### Foster an inclusive culture
Democratize discussions, empower everyone, and collect your audience's feedback to improve decision-making.
* ![User has an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Build-stronger-connections.jpg)
###### Build stronger connections
Facilitate team bonding, create transparency, and build trust between leaders and employees.
## Engage your audience with live polling.
[Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/documents/pdf/CM-2147_Slido_AAG.pdf)
Give them options Use a multiple-choice poll to capture everyone's thoughts quickly.
Or, ask them to write their own Type in custom answers or comments with open-text feedback.
Try a pop quiz Test their knowledge live with a timer and leaderboard.
Get instant feedback Get a feel for how they liked the session and topics.
Visualize keywords Display audience answers in a word cloud to see what's most popular.
Democratize prioritization Let the audience rank options based on their preferences.
## Create two-way dialogue with live Q&A.
* ![Example of a Webex Meeting with live Q&A](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Collect-questions-live.jpg)
###### Collect questions live
Participants can send in questions directly during the meeting.
* ![User listens in on a Webex Meeting Q&A session](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Moderate-Q-A-in-real-time.jpg)
###### Moderate Q&A in real time
Review incoming questions and filter to focus on relevant topics.
* ![user organizes questions with labels](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Organize-queries-with-labels.jpg)
###### Organize queries with labels
Categorize and address questions by topics to keep things efficient.
* ![User addresses questions in a Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Address-the-most-critical-questions.jpg)
###### Address the most critical questions
Let the audience upvote questions to ensure the most important concerns are addressed first.
* ![Person responds in an interactive Webex Meeting](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/wbx/us/images/rebrand/audience-engagement/Offer-more-ways-to-respond.jpg)
###### Offer more ways to respond
Reply to submitted questions as a host, then let participants comment on each other's questions.

Create together in real time or pick up after the meeting with a limitless whiteboard that's always available.

Experience frictionless whiteboarding Quickly express, show, and capture ideas on a whiteboard that never runs out of space.
Ensure everyone’s included Bring everyone together for an equally rich collaboration experience, regardless of location or devices.
Keep your ideas secure Secure by design, private by default, Webex defends against threats no matter where you’re working.

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies
  * ### Functional Cookies


#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

The future of CX is automated, personalized, and intelligent. 
Embed automation, personalization, and contextual insights throughout the customer journey—all while unlocking actionable data.
* ####  Intelligent front door 
Autonomously resolve customer requests across any voice and digital channel or multi-modal experience with proactive messaging and AI agents.
* ####  Empowered workforce 
Enable agents to resolve queries efficiently with intelligent routing, AI-powered assistance, and real-time guidance, while giving CX leaders the insights to enhance team performance and deliver trusted CX.
* ####  Data-driven insights 
Aggregate and unify complex data across every touchpoint in real time to deliver contextual insights and accelerate decision-making.
The AI-native platform for secure, scalable CX.
Webex Customer Experience solutions combine the industry-leading innovation you want with the security and scalability you need to deliver trusted CX

###  AI across the entire platform. 
AI isn’t just a feature, it’s embedded across the platform to deliver smarter insights, proactive support, and intelligent automation to enhance customer experiences, supercharge productivity, and drive operational excellence.
###  Seamless interoperability. 
No need to rip and replace, Webex Customer Experience solutions work with your on-premises systems or across diverse third-party solutions.
###  Rapid integration to your business apps. 
Connect to your essential business applications with our extensive library of pre-built integrations or deploy bespoke integrations tailored to your unique needs.
###  Unified data layer from multiple sources. 
Leverage a unified data layer to ingest inputs from multiple sources, enabling real-time profiling, predictive intelligence, and the ability to take context aware actions.
###  Trusted and secure by design. 
Your data stays protected by design with AI that operates from strict guardrails to ensure privacy, responsibility, control, all backed by Cisco to help ensure peace of mind with every interaction.

Webex AI Agent
Dynamic AI interactions that lead to customer resolutions.
[ Watch Video ](javascript:;)
[ Request a Demo ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/products/customer-experience/ai-agent.html#demo-anchor)
Reimagine self-service.
The Webex AI Agent answers inquiries and fulfills customer intents across a wide range of channels–all while delivering personalized, conversational experiences.
Deliver human-like conversations 
The AI Agent delivers interactions that feel like conversing with a real person, while also understanding an individual's needs, remembering their history, and adapting to their preferences in real-time. 
Easily design and deploy agents 
Design an AI Agent tailored to your needs with the choice to build an autonomous agent for dynamic, natural conversations or a scripted agent that uses specific, pre-configured answers. 
Fully resolve customer issues 
Powerful integrations with your back-office systems allow agents to fulfill tasks that bring complete resolutions to customer issues. 
## Answers for every customer.
#### 
Effectively handle challenging questions with an AI Agent that can quickly understand customer needs and customize every answer.
Deploy across voice and digital channels 
Scale conversations across a wide range of channels, including Voice, SMS, Email, Livechat, Facebook Messenger, Apple Messages for Business, and Whatsapp.
Provide always-on, 24/7 service 
Provide instant support for your customers whenever they need it, whether they need to schedule an appointment, troubleshoot problems or get answers to their queries.
Handoff seamlessly to human agents 
Transfer conversations seamlessly if human assistance is needed, providing the full context so agents can pick up right where the AI Agent left off.
Scale with multi-lingual agents 
Overcome language barriers with a single AI Agent that is capable of conversing in over 10 languages.
Gain real-time insights 
Evaluate the performance of AI Agents with automatic agent testing and scoring that helps you optimize interactions and maximize customer satisfaction.
##  Agentic use cases for every industry.
Webex AI Agent autonomously resolves your highest-volume interactions to drive faster resolutions, lower operational costs, and improve CSAT—across every industry.

Build an agent tailored to your needs.
Easy to build, fast to deploy, and seamlessly integrated with your existing systems–all backed by Cisco security.
Easy to design and deploy
Use a no-code / low-code, intuitive platform to design your AI Agents, enabling you to rapidly deploy to boost operational efficiency and accelerate time to value.
Flexible options to build agents
Create either autonomous agents which use LLMs for adaptive, human-like interactions, or scripted agents which use conversational AI with controlled, pre-configured responses that are ideal for sensitive data.
Trusted security and guardrails
Cisco’s stringent data security measures and reliable AI guardrails ensure trustworthy responses and help maintain safeguards.

Cisco AI Assistant for Webex Contact Center 
Unlock the full potential of customer-facing teams with AI.
[ Contact Us ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/dg/contact-sales.html)
[ Download AI Playbook ](https://explore.webex.com/cx-ai-assistant-play/webex-contact-center-20?utm_campaign=8259&utm_medium=website&utm_source=wdc&utm_term=download_eBook&utm_content=eBook_CX_AI_Assistant&utm_team=Integrated)
## Arm your agents with AI.
#### 
Built on the Cisco AI platform, the AI Assistant for Webex Contact Center provides agents and supervisors with intelligent, automated assistance that boosts productivity and generates real-time insights.
Empower agents and supervisors 
Use a rich set of intelligent features to boost agent efficiency, keep teams engaged, and enable supervisors to make quick, data-driven decisions.
Boost productivity 
Help agents be their best in every interaction by automating manual tasks, delivering contextual handoffs, and proactively addressing burnout with wellbeing notifications.
Generate actionable insights 
Use AI-powered analytics that enable customer experience leaders to operate a smarter, more efficient contact center.
Expedite training 
Onboard agents faster with AI-powered assistance that delivers quick answers and the right context to customer-facing teams, enabling expert service from the start.
#  Elevate the agent and supervisor experience.
The AI Assistant automates tasks across your contact center so your customer-facing teams can focus on delivering exceptional experiences.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/elevate-the-agent-and-supervisor-experience..jpg)
### AI Agent Transfer Summaries 
Provide accurate, automated summaries from AI Agents and IVR transfers so customers don’t have to repeat themselves.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/aI-agent-transfer-summaries-__.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Dropped Call Summaries
Ensure continuity when communication is interrupted by capturing interaction details to seamlessly resume a conversation with all the previous context.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/dropped-call-summaries.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Topic Analytics
Uses historical data to identify common reasons for customer contact and organize conversations between agents and callers by topic—making it easy to track trends and gain customer insights.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/topic-analytics.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Agent Wellbeing
Automatically identify signs of burnout and take action by re-routing calls to other agents, switching agents to a less demanding channel, or adding a break to their schedule.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/agent-wellbeing.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Automatic CSAT
Get insights on customer satisfaction for every voice interaction with automatically generated customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores through survey data, operational metrics, and call recordings.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/automatic-csat.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Real-time Assist
Improve agent efficiency and reduce onboarding time by providing agents with instant AI-suggested responses in the chat window that are contextual and tailored to the customer’s query.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/suggested-responses.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Real-time Transcription
Provide instant, accurate, and continuous transcription of conversations during live calls.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/ai/ai-assistant/real-time-transcription.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)

Integration with existing systems 
Seamlessly integrate with your existing backend systems, cloud applications, and partner services to orchestrate customer interactions and leverage your existing investments.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/products/customer-experience/cpaas/landing/vertical-tab/webex-connect.webp)
One centralized platform 
Automate all your cloud communications on one platform known as CPaaS–Communications Platform as a Service. Our messaging infrastructure combined with our API and low-code tools help enterprises lower costs, reduce complexity, and accelerate IT roadmaps.
[ Explore the platform ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/products/customer-experience/cpaas/webex-connect.html)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/products/customer-experience/cpaas/landing/vertical-tab/messaging-channels.webp)
Multiple communication channels 
SMS, RCS, WhatsApp Business, Apple Messages for Business, and more. We work with the leading messaging providers so you can provide your customers a frictionless omnichannel experience.
[ Pick your channels ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/products/customer-experience/cpaas/business-messaging.html)
Built with enterprises in mind.
Future-proof 
Our enterprise-grade infrastructure and secure platform evolves with your business, adding new channels as they emerge and staying up to date with the latest regulations. 
Centralized control 
Manage all customer interactions in one place, using real-time reporting to optimize customer journey performance and security tools to protect data and ensure compliance. 
Rapid deployment 
Build interactive journeys faster with our low-code visual flow builder and simple drag-and-drop interface. No more complex code or lengthy development cycles. 
Custom solutions for your industry needs.

#  One solution. Every agent.   
Human or AI. 
The first AI-native WEM solution built to manage human and AI agents as one—so you can meet SLAs, reduce attrition, and prove AI ROI simultaneously.
[See How it Works ](javascript:;) [Request a Demo ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/dg/contact-sales.html)
Stop managing two workforces. Start running one.
Webex AI WEM treats AI and humans as a single, high-performance ecosystem—eliminating blind spots and driving better operational efficiency.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/icons-svg/black-august/Icon-09-contact-center-AI-color-black.svg)
Staff accurately for humans & AI
Know exactly how much volume your AI agents will absorb and right-size human staffing around what's left.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/icons-svg/black-august/Icon-35-single-platform-open-platform-1-color-black.svg)
Stabilize service levels
Eliminate intraday surprises with automated recommendations and proactive adjustments.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/icons-svg/black-august/Icon-47-breakout-rooms-color-black.svg)
Reduce cost-to-serve
Optimize resources by offloading routine demand to AI while elevating human agents to complex technical issues.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/icons-svg/black-august/Icon-94-management-tasks-color-black.svg)
Improve visibility across the workforce
Break down silos by synthesizing human and AI agent metrics into a single, actionable dashboard that helps elevate agent performance and automation efficacy.

## A proven solution for industry pros.

One phone, many platforms 
Configure your platform of choice with a flexible operating system that supports Cisco Unified Communication Manager (CUCM), Webex Calling, Broadworks, or other 3rd party cloud calling platforms.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/vertical-tab-cisco-phone-9800-latest.webp)
Go beyond calling 
So much more than a desk phone with features such meetings, desk reservations, and emergency calls all in one device.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/vertical-tab-cisco-phone-9800-latest.webp)
Experience exceptional audio 
Enjoy the best audio technology with an enhanced speaker, a new bass-enhancing acoustic enclosure, AI for noise removal, and AI that ensures high-definition audio calls.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/vertical-tab-cisco-phone-9800-latest.webp)
Get best-in-class security 
Ensure unparalleled end-to-end encrypted security with the first phones in the industry to feature Trusted Platform Module (TPM) 2.0 hardware, plus top-of-the-line features including TLS 1.3, Secure Boot, Image Authentication, and network access control. Ideal for government and finance, our phones set the standard for secure communications.

### The flexibility you need in a phone.
The 9800 series runs on PhoneOS and is configurable for any calling platform. PhoneOS offers enhanced benefits for modern workers—such as advanced AI audio features and one-button-to-join any meeting.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/imags-text-9800-flexibility-latest.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
Next-generation hot desking. 
Take the stress out of going to the office.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/01-scheduler.svg)
Book in advance or on the fly. 
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/02-scan.svg)
Sit down, scan, and go with QR-code-enabled hot desking. 
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/03-contacts.svg)
View, call, and meet with your calendar and contacts at your fingertips. 
### A button made for action.
Each phone comes equipped with a customizable action button that can be configured for anything that’s important for your organization. Top use cases include emergency calls, security, access to IT support, broadcasting announcements, and more.

### The most sustainable phones in the industry.
The 9800 series phones are comprised of more than 74% post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic, contain less than 2% paint, are EnergyStar certified, and include new low power modes that ensure optimal energy efficiency and usage. In addition, carbon emission estimates are available in Control Hub. It’s our most sustainable phone yet.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/phone-series/cisco-phone-9800-series/sustainablity-9800.webp)

Control Hub is your central place to manage, support, and analyze all of your devices.

Cisco Ceiling Microphone Pro 
The best your meeting room will ever sound. 
Starting at $3,695*

![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/adaptive-microphone-intelligence-01.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/set-it-up-02.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/integrated-audiovisual-03.jpg)

* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/adaptive-microphone-intelligence-01.jpg)
Adaptive microphone intelligence 
Capture clear, high-quality voice from multiple speakers, follow changing room dynamics, and block out background noise with the first ceiling microphone to feature AI adaptive beamforming.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/set-it-up-02.jpg)
An integrated audiovisual experience 
Leverage deep integration and advanced processing between the microphone, Cisco video devices, and cameras to streamline speaker tracking and speech pickup in a variety of meeting, learning, or community spaces.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/integrated-audiovisual-03.jpg)
Quick setup, effortless management 
Remove deployment complexity with plug-and-play IP convenience, automate microphone positioning, say goodbye to external digital signal processors, and unify cloud device management.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/04-clutterfree-flexible.jpg)
Clutter-free and flexible deployment 
Create an environment where the focus stays on what matters, with a timeless design, versatile mounting options, and subtle color choices that keep the microphone discreet while supporting modern and adaptable room layouts.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/awards.svg)
8
adaptive mic beams
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/audio-over-ip-01.svg)
Audio over IP
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/zero-touch-02.svg)
Zero-touch, automatic setup
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/embedded-signal-03.svg)
Embedded processing
## Let all voices cut through the noise.
The new Cisco Ceiling Microphone Pro brings adaptive, AI-powered voice capture to meeting rooms, training rooms, and multi-purpose spaces, creating an equitable video conferencing experience where active speakers’ voices are heard with unmatched clarity.
[ Read Blog ](https://blog.webex.com/workspaces/behind-the-scenes-first-ai-adaptive-ceiling-microphone/)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/crisp-sound.jpg)
Inclusive meetings should capture every voice.
### Hear everyone in the room.
Enable authentic sound for remote participants with eight adaptive beams that intelligently focus on and dynamically capture multiple active speakers’ voices in parallel while blocking out background noise coming from other parts of the room.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/hear-everyone-01.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Unparalleled audiovisual intelligence.
It is the first microphone to use rich visual data from connected Cisco cameras and video devices to ensure precise sound pickup while providing audio intelligence for accurate speaker tracking and advanced multi-camera experiences.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/unparalled-audiovisual-02.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Feel like you’re in the same space.
Make video meetings sound perfect. Using 64 built-in microphone elements, directional voice detection, and advanced processing, the Ceiling Microphone Pro offers high signal-to-noise ratio, intelligent equalization, echo cancellation, and noise removal.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/same-space-02.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
NEW
### Smart acoustic zones. Unbeatable flexibility.
Design the ultimate flexible space with a microphone that automatically follows the conversation, even in divisible and adaptable spaces where furniture is frequently moved, and easily configure audio boundaries to ensure only participants’ voices are heard with audio exclusion zones.
![](https://cf-images.us-east-1.prod.boltdns.net/v1/jit/1384193102001/66c29b5f-348c-4f55-949c-96b2aaf637eb/main/1280x720/2s375ms/match/image.jpg)

Set it up in minutes instead of hours 
Forget about having to tune your microphones manually. Accelerate positioning at scale with a fully automated, zero-touch setup that significantly reduces the time and effort spent on AV deployment.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/embedded-digital-signal-02.jpg)
Embedded digital signal processing 
Simplify the deployment by removing the need for an external DSP unit—the microphone and the compute of the video device work together to apply intelligent processing, levelling, and mixing of all captured voices.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/plug-and-play-03.jpg)
Plug-and-play audio over IP 
Enjoy single-cable IP connectivity to the video device or scale audio coverage in larger spaces by adding multiple microphones to an Ethernet switch, and benefit from simple, hassle-free installation.
[ Explore AV over IP ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/solutions/av-over-ip-video-conferencing.html)
## Designed for discreet flexibility.
Available in Arctic White or Carbon Black, the Ceiling Microphone Pro adapts to your workspace’s interior design and can be mounted on or suspended from any standard or dropped ceiling for a tamper-proof and unobtrusive setup. The durable aluminum grille brings a sleek aesthetic to any room while the rear panel offers easy access to interfaces and streamlined cable management.
[ Play Video ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/devices/accessories/cisco-ceiling-microphone-pro/discreet-flexibility.jpg)

Engage students in a connected student community

Protect classes and student data
Webex helps you keep remote learning secure and student data private in accordance with FERPA and COPPA, as well as your own privacy and security policies.

Hybrid and distance learning. 
![Student uses gesture recognition feature in Webex Meetings](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/educations-slider-2.jpg)
Better student/teacher engagement 
Breakout into small groups to share ideas, collaborate on projects, and edit files. 
![Student enjoys clear audio and video in Webex Meetings](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/educations-slider-3.jpg)
Crystal-clear audio/video 
HD audio and video transforms virtual classrooms into lifelike experiences for students and teachers. 
![A professor meets with a student using Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/educations-slider-4.jpg)
Learning never stops 
Keep collaborating before, during, and after lessons with 1:1 and group messaging, rich content and file sharing, video calls, and more. 
![Student enjoys seamless integration of Webex with learning management system](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/edu-hybrid-5.png)
Integration with your LMS 
If your institution uses Moodle, Blackboard, Sakai, Canvas, or D2L, you can integrate Webex into your learning management system. 
![A professor enjoys a secure connection with Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/edu-hybrid_6.jpg)
Security you can trust 
Strong encryption to meet the most stringent security requirements. 
![A student studies a recording on Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/edu-hybrid_7.jpg)
Every detail captured 
Record lessons for on-demand viewing in easy-to-share MP4 formats. 
![A teacher uses the Webex white boarding feature](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/education/edu-hybrid_8.jpg)
Two-way engagement 
Digital whiteboarding, co-editing, and interactive polling mean students and teachers are always engaged, together.

# Transform healthcare outcomes with AI
Webex is here to help you transform patient experience, care team efficiency, and operations management with a single, AI-powered platform.

Patient Experience 
Improve quality of care and drive patient satisfaction. 
From coordination to critical care—Webex has you covered.
[ Learn More ](https://blog.webex.com/video-conferencing/how-webex-supports-virtual-patient/)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-2.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-2.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-2.jpg)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-2.jpg)
Improve virtual care 
Access timely diagnosis and treatment information from home using Webex Instant Connect's seamless integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems. Schedule virtual visits, teleconsultations, and more with just one click—no app installation or extra logins needed. Streamline telehealth workflows—including automated patient identification—and reduce wait times and treatment delays with on-demand video consultations for urgent care.
[ Learn More ](https://instant.webex.com/)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-2.jpg)
Deliver outstanding patient service 
Make customer support interactions delightful by empowering agents to access patient history, contextual information, and AI-suggested responses in real-time. Webex Contact Center facilitates swift handoffs or recommendations on follow-up actions, accelerates resolution, and enables proactive, personalized steps that enhance patient satisfaction.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/dg/maximize-satisfaction-minimize-costs-healthcare.html)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-2.jpg)
Enhance digital front door experience 
Streamline patient experience through personalized self-service and seamless interactions across channels, covering scheduling, billing, and responsive documentations. Webex Connect supports the entire care journey including proactive, automated, two-way appointment reminders, patient-led booking interactions, consultations, prescription refills, follow-ups, test results, and more!
[ Learn More ](https://cpaas.webex.com/solutions/healthcare)
Care Team Efficiency 
Optimize care every step of the way with Webex. 
Transform healthcare delivery while prioritizing care team wellbeing and retention.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-1.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-1.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-1.jpg)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-1.jpg)
Enhance healthcare delivery 
Improve care team efficiency with one-click-join for consultations, crystal clear audio and video, and automated notetaking—all through Webex Suite—while simultaneously maximizing time spent with patients, increasing daily patient capacity, and enhancing care delivery. Expedite patient-care decisions with enhanced sharing capabilities and centralized collaboration through both the Webex app and multi-screen Webex Room Devices setups.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/suite/collaboration-suite.html)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-1.jpg)
Increase care team retention 
Enhance your care team’s work-life balance by using Webex Instant Connect to minimize travel time with virtual rounding and telehealth solutions. Promote wellbeing for customer support teams through AI-powered insights and real-time alerts for initiating breaks at appropriate times.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.ai)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-1.jpg)
Empower your care team 
Leverage the Webex Suite’s video messaging and screen recording features to implement top-tier onboarding and training methods that augment the care team's skillsets and improve coordination between local and larger hospitals, helping ensure optimal patient care. Advance learning, professional development, and innovation through medical conferences powered by Webex Webinars and Webex Events, or use Webex Expert on Demand to enable specialist surgeons in one country to collaborate with surgeons operating real-time in other locations–particularly in remote areas.
[ Learn more ](https://www.vidcast.io/)
Operations Management 
Redefine healthcare efficiency. 
Supercharge healthcare operations with a reliable, secure, and responsible platform.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-3.jpg)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-3.jpg)

* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-3.jpg)
Reduce Did Not Attend (DNAs) rates 
Reduce operating costs and decrease missed critical care follow-ups, no-shows, or cancellations using Webex Connect’s reminders and convenient scheduling options that seamlessly integrate with healthcare systems, such as an EMR.
[ Learn More ](https://cpaas.webex.com/solutions/healthcare)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-3.jpg)
Minimize downtime 
Provide unmatched availability with Enhanced Survivability for Dedicated Instance that leverages a local node to preserve reliability—including call control, PSTN connectivity, and third-party integrations—if your organization loses its network connection due to an unforeseen event like a natural disaster.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/suite/enterprise-cloud-calling.html)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-3.jpg)
Reduce complexity and cost 
Scale with a unified Webex platform that’s easy to implement, deploy, and manage through Control Hub, eliminating the need for multiple vendors and disjointed point solutions such as communication, health management, and administrative tools or apps.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/control-hub.html)
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/healthcare/telehealth-3.jpg)
Deliver high level of security 
Rest easy with industry-leading security measures that Webex employs, including zero trust end-to-end encryption, identity verification, data privacy, built-in security controls and data loss prevention—all backed by Cisco Responsible AI principles to help safeguard patient and healthcare data.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/security.html)

Meet from your desk, conference room, or mobile device instantly, and safely.

Have confidence that government communications are authorized and compliant. Data residency keeps your private information within your country or region.

### The most advanced security.
With extensive security and privacy for meetings, messaging, events, and file transfers, Webex government solutions protect user identities, content, applications, and devices on all fronts. Features include:
  * True end-to-end encryption for messaging and meetings
  * Commitment to data privacy including privacy data sheets, data maps, and master data protection agreements
  * Data loss prevention policies that follow users beyond company lines

### One powerful and intuitive management tool.
With powerful and easy-to-use management interfaces, Webex government solutions allow for flexible, secure, and inclusive collaboration experiences, and provide access to the most advanced insights and troubleshooting capabilities available. Agencies can take advantage of:
  * Simple, automated user onboarding
  * Individual device management and workspace optimization
  * Diagnostics and proactive alert capabilities
  * Enterprise health and readiness assessments

### Devices that support your mission.
Webex devices seamlessly integrate with Webex government solutions to enable highly collaborative and flexible hybrid work environments, while retaining the highest levels of security and privacy that government agencies demand. Government Devices are designed for:
  * Conference rooms with large screens and digital whiteboards
  * Desks with video devices, telephones, cameras, and headsets

Why Webex for Financial Services. 
![User enjoys clear audio and video on Webex Meetings](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/financial-services/finance-slide_1.jpg)
High quality audio and video 
Connecting with crystal-clear HD audio and video makes you feel like you’re face to face with colleagues and clients. 
![Person meets with teammates using Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/financial-services/finance-slide_2.jpg)
Uncompromised security 
Strong encryption to meet the most stringent security requirements. 
![Person takes a Webex Meeting with a mobile device](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/financial-services/finance-slide_3.jpg)
Connect anywhere on any device 
Easily meet with the push of a button across any device—desktop, mobile, video system, or browser. 
![Person uses white boarding to collaborate with colleagues](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/financial-services/finance-slide_4.jpg)
Collaborate across branches 
Connect to colleagues instantly with group chat, messaging, content sharing, two-way digital whiteboarding, and real-time co-editing. 
![A service agent manages customer experiences with Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/financial-services/finance-slide_5.jpg)
Quick access to experts 
Ensure a superior customer experience by quickly and easily connecting clients with your experts. 
![User edits a document virtually with coworker](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/financial-services/finance-slide_6.jpg)
Virtual co-editing 
View and edit documents together virtually, and even draw your ideas with digital whiteboarding.

Why Webex for Sports & Entertainment.
