Bring your audience to you 
Stream in audience members to your show or event with HD video and crystal-clear audio. 
![Person works in the great outdoors using Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/sports-entertainment/sport-why_webex_2.jpg)
Connect to your teams 
Keep work moving behind the scenes with group messaging, file sharing, video calling, and more. 
![Person whiteboards with Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/sports-entertainment/sport-why_webex_3.jpg)
Whiteboard your ideas 
Two-way digital whiteboarding means everyone can ideate together—on a blank canvas, image, or even a video, like your game film.

Bring in the experts 
Need an expert guest? Easily connect them to your show or event to provide their commentary, in real-time. 
![Teams enjoy a secure meeting on Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/sports-entertainment/sport-why_webex_5.jpg)
Stay secure 
With the industry’s most secure collaboration platform, you have our unwavering commitment to your privacy and security. 
![Teammates have a one-on-one using Webex](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/industries/sports-entertainment/sport-why_webex_6.jpg)
One for all 
Do it all, with a collaboration platform that includes calling, messaging, meeting, and even award-winning devices.

Sustainability
#  Power hybrid work, sustainably.
We are committed to our own net zero journey. And yours, too.
[ Watch Video ](javascript:;) [Read Blog ](https://blog.webex.com/collaboration-devices/webex-sustainability-innovations/)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/sustainability/Hero.jpg)
Carbon Emissions Insights
A first of its kind in the collaboration industry, the Carbon Emissions Insights widget in Control Hub will allow companies to see estimated carbon emissions of Cisco devices and their usage.
[ Read Press Release ](https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2023/m02/new-cisco-innovation-helps-organizations-meet-sustainability-targets.html)
[ Read Press Release ](https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2023/m02/new-cisco-innovation-helps-organizations-meet-sustainability-targets.html)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/single-platform-open-platform-2.svg)
Monitor emissions
Estimate energy usage and related carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emissions from Cisco collaboration devices.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/insights-analytics.svg)
Track trends
See emission trends over time, and track the progress towards your sustainability goals.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/icons/Groundbreaking.svg)
Take action
Guide IT administrators to enable features like office hours to reduce their Cisco devices energy usage.

Easy to repair, refurbish, and recycle – meet the Cisco Room Bar, our most sustainable device to date.

### Streamline operations and save energy
Turn on office hours in Control Hub to prevent your device from using unnecessary energy. Utilize insights from embedded sensors to optimize HVAC.
[ View Infographic ](https://alln-extcloud-storage.cisco.com/Cisco_Blogs%3Ablogs/101/2022/11/Optimizing-your-Webex-devices.pdf)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/sustainability/Streamline.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
Collaborate on a more sustainable future.
Smart power modes
With each product iteration, our goal is to design our devices to consume less energy.
Actionable insights through Control Hub
Get insights into real-time device usage, allowing you to optimize your buildings and workspaces.
Reduce travel-related emissions
Experience virtual meetings on Cisco devices that rival in-person interactions.
Free product takebacks and recycling
Cisco is dedicated to recycling, reusing, or refurbishing returned hardware with 99.9% efficiency.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/sustainability/Green-pay.jpg)
Cisco Green Pay
Achieve your sustainability goals with cost-efficient financing options.
[ Learn More ](https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2022/m04/cisco-launches-circular-it-payment-solution-to-support-customer-sustainability-goals.html)
Learn more about our efforts for net zero emissions. 
What is the circular economy? 
See how Cisco is moving towards a circular economy that better cares for our limited natural resources. 
[ Learn More ](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/about/circular-economy.html)
Cisco targets net zero by 2040 
Cisco is committed to reaching net zero across their value chain by 2040. 
[ Read Article  ](https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2021/m09/hold-fran-net-zero-blog.html)
Reducing the usage of plastic 
Cisco is setting even higher targets towards reducing plastic in products and packaging. 
[ Read Blog ](https://blogs.cisco.com/csr/cisco-increases-focus-on-reducing-use-of-plastics)
Cisco Refresh 
Get fully remanufactured Cisco collaboration devices for significant savings – both monetary and environmental. 
[ Find out more ](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/remanufactured.html)

## Consent Manager
  * ### Your Privacy
  * ### Strictly Necessary Cookies
  * ### Performance Cookies
  * ### Targeting Cookies
  * ### Functional Cookies


#### Your Privacy
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. From the list on left, please choose whether this site may use Performance and/or Targeting Cookies. By selecting Strictly Necessary Cookies only, you are requesting Cisco not to sell or share your personal data. Note, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer.
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Cookies Details
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies provide metrics related to the performance and usability of our site. They are primarily focused on gathering information about how you interact with our site, including: page load times, response times, error messages, and allowing a replay of a visitor’s interactions with our site, which enables us to review and analyze visitor behavior, helping to improve site usability and functionality. These cookies also allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Cookies Details
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Camera Intelligence for Video Conferencing
#  Get the best view in any meeting.

## Experience cinematic meetings.
Deliver truly immersive experiences for every participant with AI-driven camera views, optimized framing and seamless tracking that ensure facial expressions, body language, and in-room context never get lost.

A front-row seat for everyone.
DYNAMIC MODE
### Brilliant views, directed by AI.
Bring intelligent framing to every meeting with the agentic AI director that dynamically optimizes camera views, without the need for manual switching, by analyzing factors such as room size, participant count, seating positions, and the activity level in the space, ensuring every participant is optimally framed—every time.
[ Watch Agentic Camera AI ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/camera-intelligence-for-cisco-devices/brilliantviews-directedby.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
FRAMES
### Level the playing field.
Ensure equal representation with AI and smart camera techniques that dynamically crop video feeds for ideal framing while maximizing screen utilization. Available on any meeting platform, the frames camera mode now features two-row layouts for enhanced views around tapered or video-centric tables.
[ Watch in Action ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/camera-intelligence-for-cisco-devices/level-the-playing-field-01.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
SPEAKER TRACKING
### Keep the speaker in focus.
Bring the active speaker front and center and follow the flow of the conversation with seamless, touch-free transitions between speakers to deliver an engaging, cinematic experience for remote participants.
[ Watch in Action ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/camera-intelligence-for-cisco-devices/keep-the-speaker-in-focus-02.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
PRESENTERTRACK
### Experience truly engaging presentations.
Foster equity during hybrid presentations and learning sessions with intelligent camera tracking and silent pan-tilt-zoom technology so remote attendees can effortlessly follow the presenters—even as they move around a large stage.
[ Watch in Action ](javascript:;)
![](https://cf-images.us-east-1.prod.boltdns.net/v1/jit/1384193102001/104630c4-17ba-4b3a-8a24-b9029be9af74/main/1280x720/13s933ms/match/image.jpg)

Multi-camera intelligence for cinematic meetings.
[ View Workspaces ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/workspaces.html)
MULTI-CAMERA TRACKING
### Capture every point of view.
Discover next-generation dual-camera framing, speaker tracking, and smart compositing. Cisco tracking cameras allow for flexible placement, versatile angle adjustment, and optimal height when combined with ultra-wide and large-format displays while extending the field of view in wide rooms.
[ Explore Multi-Camera Tracking ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/devices/room-series/cisco-room-kit-pro.html)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/camera-intelligence-for-cisco-devices/ping-pong-capture-every-point.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
CROSS-VIEW | DUAL CROSS-VIEW
### Follow the dynamics.
Experience studio-grade video conferencing with adaptive camera switching. By deploying multiple Room Vision PTZ cameras in medium-to-long rooms, you can deliver an equitable experience for remote participants by automatically capturing front-facing views of active speakers—even as they turn away from the main system, interact across the table, or walk around the room.

Control Hub for Collaboration Devices
# Simplify device admin. Elevate workspace management.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/new-hero-still.jpg)
Work has changed. It’s time to rethink workspace management.
Traditional management solutions can stifle workplace transformation efforts due to:
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/01-new-remote-access.svg)
Management complexity
The inability to remotely access and gain a comprehensive view of collaboration device deployments.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/02-new-manual-processes.svg)
Manual, reactive processes
The dependency on manual processes to identify workspaces in urgent need of attention and quickly resolve technology issues.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/03-new-lack-of-visibility.svg)
Lack of utilization insights
A lack of visibility into collaboration technology adoption, workspace conditions, and space utilization trends.
## A single portal to manage your devices and workspaces.
Control Hub is your all-in-one admin dashboard, empowering you to manage collaboration device deployments at scale, leverage proactive, AI-powered workspace monitoring, and gain unrivaled analytics to optimize your spaces.
[ Watch Video ](javascript:;)

Workspace Advisor
View a digital replica of your physical meeting room within Control Hub to gain visibility and recommendations on how to create the ideal setup and optimize functionality, ensuring every space delivers the best experience for end users.
Manage all your devices, from anywhere.
Take control of your collaboration device deployment while reducing IT overhead.
### Scale and streamline management with AgenticOps
Access Control Hub workspace data through your favorite AI Agents for seamless, conversational management from anywhere.
[ Watch Video ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/new-agentic-ops.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Your rooms, now plug-and-play
Zero-touch provisioning simplifies device onboarding by enabling admins to add inventory, pre-configure, and set up devices in Control Hub. Once on-site, simply plug them in for instant collaboration.
[ Watch Video ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/new-plug-and-play.webp)
### Remotely access your collaboration devices
Right from your desk, you can remotely provision a device, support an in-room user, and gain real-time insights into your workspace with the ability to view and interact with Cisco video devices, displays, and control panels.
[ Learn More ](https://blog.webex.com/workspaces/industry-first-ai-for-workspaces/)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/01-new-remotely-access.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### See a complete inventory of device deployments
Access a visual overview of your Cisco devices, Cisco accessories, and third-party peripherals with instant health status, automatic software upgrades, and advanced configurations for a single device or an entire campus.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices/02-new-complete-inventory.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Stay informed with instant notifications
Get real-time notifications and alerts whenever issues arise, so you can easily troubleshoot while keeping devices up and running and your employees productive.
![](https://cf-images.us-east-1.prod.boltdns.net/v1/jit/1384193102001/39e08f7d-6a23-4862-9190-19d1ca79044c/main/1280x720/2s850ms/match/image.jpg)

### No distractions, just productive meetings
Set up virtual meeting zones to only capture and frame in-room participants, block out distracting background noises, and leverage an AI director to automatically switch to the best camera angle.

Deliver vibrant presentations using a wide range of wireless and wired content sharing options and get seamless BYOD video meetings via USB passthrough.

AV over IP for Video Conferencing 
Simplify your meeting spaces at scale. 
[ Contact Us ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/dg/contact-sales.html)
Conference room complexity is a barrier to innovation.
#1
challenge to enterprise collaboration is meeting room setup complexity.1
50%
of IT, Ops, and Facilities decision-makers aim to optimize meeting room design and reduce implementation costs.2
1 out of 2
employees stated that meeting spaces aren’t prepared to support hybrid working needs.3
## One click to distance zero.
Eliminate setup headaches, simplify management, and enjoy an integrated room experience with the latest AV-over-IP-enabled video devices and networked conferencing accessories that transmit power, audiovisual signals, and controls over Ethernet.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/av-over-ip-video-conferencing/updated-connected-workspaces.jpg)
Turn IP connectivity into AV convenience.
### Set up in minutes, not hours.
Eliminate the need for advanced systems integration and avoid hours of troubleshooting with a plug-and-play setup experience that makes deployment a breeze. Cisco room peripherals connect seamlessly over IP resulting in lower installation effort, reduced costs, and simple maintenance.
[ Watch Video ](javascript:;)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/av-over-ip-video-conferencing/set-it-up-in-minutes.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Make your spaces click.
Say goodbye to extenders, power adapters, digital signal processors, bandwidth limitations, and cable clutter. With AV over IP, you can significantly lower the complexity of a new build or a technology refresh program by reducing your conferencing hardware footprint and enabling hassle-free cable management.
[ Read Blog ](https://blog.webex.com/workspaces/make-your-workspaces-click-where-camera-tracking-meets-ip-simplicity/)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/av-over-ip-video-conferencing/make-your-spaces-click.jpg/_jcr_content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg)
### Device management, without the blind spots.
Gain zero-touch provisioning and unified management of all networked peripherals, switches, and third-party room components. Your IT and AV teams can do more while ensuring a consistent, seamless experience across every space.

Get secure end-to-end control 
Provision users, set security settings, and manage Webex services and devices for your hybrid workforce.
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/controlhb_verticle_tab2.jpg)
Troubleshoot in real time 
Boost employee experience and productivity by diagnosing technical issues faster and assessing user setups.​​
* ![image](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/controlhb_verticle_tab3.jpg)
Support teams without any disruption 
Remove friction points and drive better changes with IoT sensors and AI-enabled features.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/controlhub_itadmin.jpg)
The IT Administrator Guide to Supporting a Hybrid Workplace
Control Hub provides an easy-to-use, intuitive way to navigate and manage Webex services.
[ Get the Report ](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/datasheets/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/it-admin-guide-to-supporting-a-hybrid-workplace.pdf)
Create a seamless, smarter admin experience.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/insights-analytics.svg)
Understand operations at every level
Get real-time insights into user adoption and engagement, historical quality of service, calling metrics, Webex messaging engagement, and device utilization.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/physical-workspaces.svg)
Check in on physical workspaces
Measure devices in use, occupancy, room acoustics, room air quality, temperature, humidity, and room lighting with IoT environment sensors.
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/webex-devices.svg)
Simplify device management
Support your hybrid workforce with seamless device activation, provisioning, and ongoing management for remote teams, office spaces, and anywhere in between.
[ Learn More ](https://www.webex.com/us/en/solutions/control-hub-cisco-devices.html)
![](https://www.webex.com/content/dam/www/us/en/images/solutions/cross-platform/control-hub/voice-recognition.svg)
Easily import and sync users
Keep everyone and everything updated with zero-touch provisioning for any identity provider, whether on-prem or in the cloud.
